studio.story: The Tall Men is a creative marketing agency based in Cairo. We work with automotive, food & beverage, fitness, beauty, corporate and real-estate brands, from the first insight to the final cut and the media plan that puts it in front of people.

points.text: We start with the audience and the market, not with the format. The idea comes from what people actually care about.
Film, design and content made with taste, so the work earns the next second of someone's time.
Every campaign is read honestly after launch. What worked is pushed further, what didn't is fixed.
